title: Foundry Stack Profile
description: The declarative, versioned bundle of stack-specific knowledge the generic factory loads once intake establishes the active stack (FACTORY-EVOLUTION-PLAN Phase 2 / §1). Operator-curated machinery (trusted-operator); this schema is a mechanical mistake-catcher, not adversary-defense.

allOf.comment: Draft-07-safe conditional (AC-SPIB-1): the if/then toggles ONLY the `required` array. Properties are declared ONCE at top level under the single `additionalProperties:false` above — NEVER re-declared or re-closed in a branch (avoids the draft-07 fail-open/unsatisfiable footgun).

AC-PSP-2/3 (feat-foundry-python-stack-profile): the additive `library` kind — a SECOND allOf member, toggling ONLY `required`, exactly the precedent above. `app_exercise_binding` is required only in the `else` of an `infra`-or-`library` test, so `infra` and `library` both drop it from required (infra already had no boot recipe; library is the new no-runtime-surface claim) while an absent or `app` kind is unchanged (ANDed with the member above, still requiring static_validation+test_recipe+app_exercise_binding for app/absent).

profile_kind.description: OPTIONAL discriminator (AC-SPIB-1; extended AC-PSP-2/3 with `library`). Absent ⇒ app (existing profiles, incl. node-web, validate byte-identically). `app` ⇒ the app-shaped static_validation/test_recipe/app_exercise_binding are required; `infra` ⇒ those drop from required and `infra_binding` joins required; `library` ⇒ static_validation+test_recipe stay required but app_exercise_binding drops (an explicit, operator-authored claim of no runtime surface to boot — never inferred). The closed enum {app,infra,library} fails closed on any other value.

version.description: The pack's OWN semver, independent of the core.

requires_core.description: Core-compatibility range: lower-bound-only '>=X.Y[.Z]' (non-speculative, admits any core >= lower — preferred) OR two-bound '>=X.Y[.Z],<X.Y[.Z]' (cap ONLY on a demonstrated incompatibility). Byte-equivalent to foundry-stack-profile.py _parse_range. Enforced at load (D4 guardrail 2).

implementation_skills.description: Pointers to skill files the generic worker loads (relative to the profile dir).

boot.description: The live-seam boot command for this stack (the generic analog of `make dev`).

infra_binding.description: AC-SPIB-2: the IaC lifecycle binding for `profile_kind: infra`. plan/verify/policy are the READ-ONLY slots, apply the MUTATION slot (the read-role guard is enforced by the loader's stack-profile-infra-binding check, not by JSON Schema). Declarative data — the schema neither runs nor (beyond shape) trusts the commands.

apply.description: The MUTATION command string (e.g. `tofu apply`) — operator-authored, executed as written when decide_apply's total table routes to EXECUTE. The bound on what it may do is the IAM restrictions of the AWS context the operator supplies; beyond this shape (a non-empty string), the framework carries no check on its content.

verify.description: READ-ONLY post-state verify command string (e.g. `kubectl get … --dry-run=server` / `argocd app get`).

policy.description: READ-ONLY policy-as-code command string (e.g. `conftest test` / `helm template … | conftest`).

gitops_paths.description: Path globs naming the ArgoCD-managed manifest paths id-apply's classify_gitops re-derives against. May be empty for a non-GitOps target.

gitops_enabled.description: AC-GOP-1 (ER #89): OPTIONAL explicit GitOps capability toggle. false => GitOps is N/A by DECLARATION for this target (a directly-applied cluster / Helm-only pipeline) — gitops_paths must be EMPTY (a contradiction fails closed at the loader) and the id-* steps drive only the applicable slots. true => GitOps is load-bearing — gitops_paths must be NON-EMPTY (a declared-but-pathless GitOps profile fails closed; no silent skip). ABSENT => the legacy semantics, byte-unchanged.

work_dirs.description: AC-IDMULTI-1 (FF-3 / ER #57): OPTIONAL per-ROLE working-dir map for the two-CWD command split. The id-* driver runs a slot command's `tofu` part with CWD = work_dirs.infra and its render part (`helm template`/`kustomize build`) with CWD = work_dirs.gitops. RELATIVE paths confined under the active code repo's root — the loader REJECTS an absolute path, a `..` segment, or a resolved escape (containment precedent). ABSENT ⇒ single-dir: every part runs in the one existing CWD (back-compat; existing profiles validate byte-identically).

infra.description: Repo-relative dir the `tofu` (plan/validate/output/fmt) part runs in (e.g. `terraform/envs/staging`).

gitops.description: Repo-relative dir the render part (`helm template`/`kustomize build`) runs in (e.g. `gitops`).

blast_radius.description: MACHINE-EVALUABLE blast-radius tier rules (not free-text). Each rule lets id-impact mechanically match a plan action to a tier. MUST contain ≥1 HIGH rule (enforced by the loader check).

attr.description: Optional attribute qualifier (e.g. an attribute whose change drives the tier).

standing-versions.description: AC-SVM-5 (feat-foundry-standing-versions-matrix, ID-SV-1): the profile's standing-versions/ DATA artifact set (the flat pin BOM + the platform-anchored compatibility file), admitted + typed as a recognized member of an infra profile's contract. OPTIONAL at the schema layer (not added to the profile_kind:infra `then.required` — a synthetic/minimal infra fixture elsewhere in the doctor's own selftest corpus that predates this atom must keep validating unchanged; widening `required` there is an out-of-scope blast this atom does not take). STRUCTURAL TYPING WHEN PRESENT: a profile is schema-INVALID when a DECLARED `standing-versions` member is the wrong JSON type, or a required member key (`manifest.path` / `compatibility.path`) is missing; a profile declaring every required member present and of the schema-declared type validates. For THIS atom's shipped profile (aws-eks-karpenter), the block's actual presence — and the on-disk existence of manifest.yaml/compatibility.yaml — is asserted fail-closed by the AC-SVM-4 certified-content (immutability) step, not by this schema alone: a JSON Schema over the profile DOCUMENT cannot itself require separate on-disk files to exist, and a declared-but-file-missing block is rejected there (scripts/foundry-stack-profile.py `_standing_versions_sha256_of`). Whether each individual pin inside the artifacts is well-formed (pin-shape validation) is a different, deferred concern (ID-SV-2).

manifest.description: The flat pin BOM member (AC-SVM-1) — standing-versions/manifest.yaml.

path.description: Profile-dir-relative path to the pin BOM (e.g. standing-versions/manifest.yaml).

compatibility.description: The platform-anchored compatibility + skew member (AC-SVM-2) — standing-versions/compatibility.yaml.

path.description: Profile-dir-relative path to the compatibility file (e.g. standing-versions/compatibility.yaml).
